note: How an editor's own customization view names what Free Rein reads: its sections (Free Rein's kinds of customization, in its order and words), its scopes, and the agents (harnesses) you can pick in it, each read as one of Free Rein's runtimes. Free Rein's wording, not the editors'; only the section names are theirs. A section's pieces are the ones that window edits directly. Hooks are files you edit there; the pieces a hook backs are not listed, because that window does not edit them as pieces.
